strategy_lineage: gor-qreg-252-63-v1; ATM-COST-2026-08-28-BPS25 descriptive replay plus fixed App-cost product acceptance
hypothesis: The gold-to-WTI ratio classifies a slow macro regime: above its prior one-year common-observation mean indicates defensive or growth-stress conditions favoring gold, while at or below the mean indicates growth and risk-asset conditions favoring Nasdaq. Reviewing quarterly should make the signal economically interpretable and product-cost tolerant.
allowed_changes: one immutable precomputed target schedule replayed at BPS25 and App product cost
fixed cash, state-independent 50/50 and sign-reversal falsification controls
mechanical reporting of frozen windows and stress periods
selection_metric: No optimization or candidate selection. The one frozen candidate is evaluated once; only App 1.00% fee plus 0.05% slippage determines product acceptance.
pass_fail_gates: App-cost full-history, last-10-calendar-years, 2020+ and 2022+ CAGR each >=10%
App-cost full-history, last-10-calendar-years, 2020+ and 2022+ MDD each <=10%
GFC, COVID and 2022 tightening MDD each <=15%
App-cost full-history CAGR greater than CashYieldCNY control
App-cost full-history Sharpe greater than state-independent naturally drifting 50/50 gold-Nasdaq control
App-cost full-history Sharpe greater than sign-reversal falsification control
the exact same immutable schedule object/fingerprint, event dates and target weights are used for BPS25 and App-cost replays
maximum requested and marked-to-market actual gross <=100%; target weights, holdings and cash nonnegative; no shorting, financing or signal-only asset trades
all frozen schedule, strict T-1, common-observation and clock-v3 contract tests pass
follow_up_policy: If any gate fails, record REJECTED and stop. No 126/200/240/504 lookback, 21/42/126 review interval, median/EMA/z-score/quantile, lag confirmation, reversed mapping, oil-only or alternate ratio, partial allocation, 50/50 blend, risk parity, buffer, stop loss, month-end anchor, cost substitution or post-result rescue is allowed. A genuinely different mechanism requires a new lineage and preregistration.
swift_engine_entrypoint: scripts/run_gor_qreg_252_63_formal.py -> tools/gor_qreg_252_63_formal.swiftpart + GORQREG25263Strategy.makeSchedule -> BacktestEngine.runResearchTargetProviderStrategyWithTrace frozenSchedule -> shared BacktestDailySimulator
expected_outputs: formal BPS25 and App-cost full-history, last-10-years, 2020+, 2022+ and frozen stress-period metrics
cash, naturally drifting 50/50 and sign-reversal control metrics
immutable schedule CSV, fingerprint and event count
portfolio paths, constraints, execution record, stdout/stderr and SHA-256 artifact manifest

candidate_definition.common_observation: gold_cny, oil_wti_cny, nasdaq and usd_per_cny must all be observed=true, finite and positive on the same aligned date; forward-filled values never advance the signal clock
candidate_definition.lookback: arithmetic mean of exactly the previous 252 common-observation R values, s-252 through s-1, excluding current R_s
candidate_definition.review_grid: common-observation ordinals 252,315,378,... only; invalid values consume the fixed anchor and preserve the prior target
candidate_definition.mapping: R_s > prior252Mean targets 100% gold_cny; R_s <= prior252Mean targets 100% nasdaq
candidate_definition.same_state: no target event and no drift rebalancing
candidate_definition.warmup: 100% CashYieldCNY until the first target executes
candidate_definition.causality: schedule event is formed at signal date s and executes no earlier than the next common real observation under strict T-1
candidate_definition.execution: sell before buy; cross-market proceeds buy no earlier than the next complete common observation; no leverage, financing, shorting or signal-only trades

cost_models.modeling_rule: Both costs replay the same precomputed immutable schedule. Low-cost results cannot substitute for App-cost acceptance.

evaluation_windows.full_history: all available frozen App fixture history after engine warmup
evaluation_windows.last_10_years: latest portfolio date minus exactly 10 calendar years through latest

controls.cash_yield_cny: same frame and warmup; no target events
controls.state_independent_50_50: at first review establish 50% gold and 50% Nasdaq once, then naturally drift without periodic rebalancing
controls.sign_reversal_falsification: same schedule dates but invert the candidate gold/Nasdaq mapping

forbidden_changes: any alternate lookback or review interval
any alternate statistic, ratio, asset, threshold, mapping or confirmation
any periodic rebalance within an unchanged state
any leverage, financing, shorting, negative cash or signal-only asset trade
any product decision based on BPS25
any post-result rescue or replacement within this trial
